parameters.query:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT m.user_id
  FROM matches m
  JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id
  WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid
    AND m.notified = false
  GROUP BY m.user_id
  ORDER BY count(*) DESC, m.user_id
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score,
       m.match_id, p.product_name, p.source, p.interest_rate, m.score
FROM picked pk
JOIN matches m ON m.user_id = pk.user_id AND m.notified = false
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id
JOIN loan_products p ON p.product_id = m.product_id
ORDER BY u.user_id, m.score DESC;
